rules.name: High Hydrocarbon Probability
rules.message: Hydrocarbon probability exceeds the configured threshold.
rules.recommendation: Review resistivity, porosity and saturation support for this interval.

rules.name: Critical Water Saturation
rules.message: Predicted water saturation is above the critical limit.
rules.recommendation: Review fluid interpretation, Rw and Archie parameters.

rules.name: Low Reservoir Porosity
rules.message: Predicted porosity is below the configured reservoir-quality limit.
rules.recommendation: Review lithology, compaction and density-neutron response.

rules.name: Low Reservoir Permeability
rules.message: Predicted permeability is below the economic-screening threshold.
rules.recommendation: Review pore-throat quality and completion implications.

rules.name: Poor Reservoir Quality
rules.message: The inferred reservoir-quality class is poor.
rules.recommendation: Review the interval before selecting completion or test points.

rules.name: Missing Critical Curves
rules.message: One or more critical well-log features are missing.
rules.recommendation: Check ingestion mappings and curve availability.

rules.name: Gamma Ray Spike
rules.message: Gamma ray changed sharply relative to the previous sample.
rules.recommendation: Inspect acquisition quality, washout and tool stability.

rules.name: Resistivity Anomaly
rules.message: Resistivity exhibits an abrupt percentage change.
rules.recommendation: Check tool response, invasion effects and depth alignment.

rules.name: Low AI Readiness
rules.message: The input is not considered AI-ready.
rules.recommendation: Review preprocessing warnings, missing features and QC results.

rules.name: Prospective Pay Zone
rules.message: The interval satisfies composite pay criteria.
rules.recommendation: Flag the interval for petrophysical validation and possible testing.
